principles: One hypothesis per immutable experiment ID
No parameter search after seeing final holdout
Separate asset classes and data-quality eligibility
No strategy promotion from a citation or in-sample result
Paper account is for execution validation after offline pre-screen, not for statistical discovery

tranches.name: Reproduce corrected baselines
tranches.gate: Exact reproducibility and data-quality validation; no alpha claim.

tranches.name: Trend and breakout
tranches.gate: Next-open OOS positive net utility, robust folds and costs.

tranches.name: Mean reversion
tranches.gate: Enough independent trades; no family-wise significant false discovery; benchmark improvement.

tranches.name: Relative value and pairs
hypotheses: pairs momentum vs short-term reversal decomposition
tranches.gate: Long/short legs simulated only; no Paper orders under cash-only/no-short account; borrow and legging costs included.

tranches.name: Allocation and risk overlays
tranches.gate: Compare allocation overlays with identical signals; no leverage; stress correlation spikes.

tranches.name: Calendar and event
hypotheses: earnings drift when PIT data exists
tranches.gate: Timestamp provenance, placebo and negative controls, independent source groups, incremental value after latency/costs.

tranches.name: Intraday and execution
tranches.gate: Requires suitable intraday trades/quotes and auction data; daily/IEX bars are not enough.

tranches.name: ML and advanced methods
tranches.gate: Only after simpler baselines pass; nested purged walk-forward, embargo, stable calibration and multiple-testing control.

tranches.name: Paper operational validation
tranches.gate: Explicit capped order budget, verified Paper-only credentials/account, cash-only and no-short constraints, reconciliation PASS, kill switch and zero live path.
